scripts.check: pnpm shape && pnpm format:check && pnpm generate:check && pnpm seed:check && pnpm lint && pnpm types && pnpm test && pnpm delta:check && pnpm ratchets && pnpm words
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter '!@capxul/contracts' --if-present run test && pnpm frappe:test && pnpm door:test && pnpm status:test
scripts.generate: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter @capxul/generate generate && pnpm --filter @capxul/generate ratchets --write
scripts.generate:check: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter @capxul/generate generate --check && pnpm --filter @capxul/generate ratchets --check
scripts.seed: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter @capxul/generate seed && pnpm generate
scripts.contracts:build: cd packages/contracts && forge build --skip test --skip script
